curation_notes: DRAFT — not yet read by a human against the official page. Do not ship.

Taken from the English page of the Commissionerate for Welfare of the Differently Abled (scd.tn.gov.in) on 2026-08-09. Unlike the pension files, this source is the department's own English page and it lists the documents, so the sourcing here is strong.
The official page carries 'Last Update April 2024'. Amounts may have changed since; confirm before marking verified.

FOUR SEPARATE ALLOWANCES share this page, each with its own disability condition. They are not variants of one scheme and must not be merged. This is also why our sources appeared to disagree on the disability threshold: 40% here, more than 75% for severely affected, and different figures again for the Revenue Department pensions.

All four share the same three documents — UDID card, family card and bank details. That makes them the best demonstration in the corpus of the de-duplicated document checklist: three documents unlock four schemes.
Needs an extra document the other three do not: 'A certificate from doctor stating that the applicant is not curable by surgical/other means'.

The official page says inmates of Government Rehabilitation Homes are eligible. Whether the allowance is ONLY for them is not clear from the wording — settle it before this ships, because it would be a large restriction.
